name: Decoupled SVO Compression
definition: A compression scheme for Sparse Voxel Octrees (SVOs) that decouples geometry (topology) from voxel attributes (color, normals, etc.), allowing separate compression methods for topology and attributes to reduce memory usage significantly compared to standard SVOs or naive colored DAGs.
summary: Decoupled SVO Compression separates geometry from attributes to enable specialized compression, achieving superior memory reduction and visual quality compared to standard SVOs.
